profile_text.body:
Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) is a nonprofit founded in 2000 and headquartered in Berkeley, California. The organization describes itself as focused on preventing human extinction from artificial superintelligence. According to its website, MIRI has worked for over two decades to understand and prepare for the critical challenges that humanity will face as it transitions to a world with artificial superintelligence, and claims its technical and philosophical work helped found the field of AI alignment.

MIRI's site emphasizes that recent rapid advances in artificial intelligence have dramatically shortened estimates of when superintelligence will arrive, while technical progress on safety, alignment, and control has failed to keep up. The organization states that humanity does not understand the internal workings of present systems well enough to completely control them or robustly steer their behaviors, let alone the far more powerful and complex systems expected in the coming years. MIRI's researchers originated many of the theories and concepts central to today's discussions of artificial intelligence.
